_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate plus Denial-band fear_greed and no breaker (CVD/liquidity conflict unresolved) make HOLD the graded call; bottom analog is forward context only.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; analyst explicit HOLD, narrative silent/measured with no opposing direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds ~1.5% weekend range and fear_greed stays 32-38
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC moves >~2% or fear_greed breaks <31 or >39 (Panic or Anxiety)
